verdict.rationale: Docusign documents an eSignature REST API, published OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and an official Node.js client to send, sign, and approve documents, so core agreement actions are reachable programmatically. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows parity with UI features such as the drag-and-drop CLM workflow designer, the web-forms builder, AI-Assisted Review, or Identify settings. Community reports conflict: one calls the API 'an afterthought' and one hit an embedded-flow problem that forced a move to a legacy API version, while others report thorough docs and smooth integrations. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of UI-only features (CLM drag-and-drop designer, web-forms builder, AI review), an explicit API–UI parity statement, and independent confirmation of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
